svg.title: Ray service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for a Ray cluster: GCS server, dashboard, and autoscaler on the head node; raylet, core worker, and runtime env agent on each worker node — coarse-grained separately deployable platform services with clear responsibilities.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do Ray drivers and clients submit work to a Ray cluster?')
g.text: Submit tasks and actors to the cluster
Cluster-wide coordination services — separately runnable platform components

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the GCS server do in a Ray cluster?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ray dashboard service provide?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ray autoscaler do?')

svg.text: Head node also runs a raylet and core worker for local task execution
Worker nodes — one set of services per node, independently deployed

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the raylet do in Ray?')
sendPrompt('What does a Ray core worker do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Ray runtime environment agent do?')
sendPrompt('What is the Ray distributed object store (Plasma)?')
g.text: Shared memory for task inputs and outputs across workers

svg.text: Coarse-grained platform services — not fine-grained business microservices
